title: 0 Of 7 Brain Networks Supported The Left-Right Personality Myth
hook: 0 of 7 brain networks supported your supposed personality side.
closing: Your brain works as one team, not a left-or-right personality type.
question: Were you labeled left- or right-brained?

segments.say: Language leans left in 96 percent of right-handers. Specialized functions do not create a one-sided personality.
None of the 7 brain networks matched the myth. The personality split failed direct testing.
About 200 million nerve fibers connect the hemispheres. Both sides exchange signals constantly.
